verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents an AI avatar interview feature that collects responses and turns them into an AI-generated report alongside individual responses and transcripts. That is a genuine in-product AI insight capability over user-collected data, but it is limited to that one interview workflow. missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions across the user's broader workspace data (e.g., video engagement analytics), proactive AI recommendations, documentation of report depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
